items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 October 2026 4:03pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 03 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasionally strong wind in places later in the period.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure over most of the British Isles. Low to the west of Iceland, moving to the Norwegian Sea, with a new low expected to the southwest of Iceland later.


##Wind##

West or southwest, imminently backing south or southwest, 2 to 4 soon increasing 4 or 5, although still 3 or 4 in Liverpool Bay and near the Lancashire coast, then occasional 6 in central parts of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
